title: Key role of persistent free radicals in soil for persulfate activation: impacts on benzo[a]pyrene degradation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00437J, Paper
Yiwen Ou, Xintong Li, Shixu Feng, Hongxia Zhao
Environmentally persistent free radicals (EPFRs) activated persulfate to produce reactive oxygen species (ROS) in soil. The generation of ROS can degrade B[a]P to intermediates via oxidation, ringopening, and mineralization.
